title: Unified Multi-plane Autoregressive Diffusion for 3D Multi-contrast MRI Synthesis
title_zh: 统一多平面自回归扩散模型：用于三维多对比度MRI合成

paragraphs.en: Acquiring a complete set of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) contrasts is time-intensive and uncomfortable for patients, despite the diagnostic value of multi-contrast imaging. This motivates synthesizing missing contrasts from those already acquired, which is an inherently 3D problem requiring anatomical coherence across axial, sagittal, and coronal planes. However, fully 3D generative models are often impractical under computational resources that scale cubically with volume size. We propose a unified Multi-Plane Autoregressive Diffusion (MPAD), a latent diffusion framework that achieves full-volume 3D synthesis using efficient plane-wise 2D operations while preserving volumetric coherence. A 3D autoencoder first compresses MRI scans into an isotropic 3D latent representation. A 2D diffusion model is then trained to reconstruct masked latent slices of the target contrast, conditioned on both source-contrast slices and unmasked target-contrast slices. During inference, we introduce plane-wise autoregressive synthesis with inter-plane priors. Slices are generated autoregressively in random order within one plane orientation to maintain intra-plane continuity, then propagated as conditioning priors to orthogonal plane orientations to enforce inter-plane consistency. Compared to 3D latent diffusion baselines, MPAD reduces training and inference FLOPs by 7× and 3×, respectively, while also lowering inference time and peak memory consumption. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that MPAD achieves superior performance, generating high-fidelity 3D volumes and supporting one-to-many translation within a single unified model.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管多对比度成像具有诊断价值，但获取一套完整的磁共振成像（MRI）对比度图像既耗时又令患者感到不适。 这促使人们尝试从已获取的对比度图像中合成缺失的对比度，而这一问题本质上是一个三维问题，需要在轴位、矢状位和冠状位平面之间保持解剖学上的连贯性。 然而，在计算资源随体积大小呈三次方增长的情况下，完全三维的生成模型通常难以实际应用。 我们提出了一种统一的“多平面自回归扩散”（MPAD）方法，这是一种潜在扩散框架，通过高效的平面级二维操作实现全体积的三维合成，同时保持体积连贯性。 首先，一个三维自编码器将MRI扫描图像压缩为各向同性的三维潜在表示。 接着，训练一个二维扩散模型，以源对比度切片和未掩码的目标对比度切片为条件，重建目标对比度的掩码潜在切片。 在推理阶段，我们引入了带有平面间先验的平面级自回归合成方法。 切片在一个平面方向内以随机顺序进行自回归生成，以保持平面内的连续性；随后，这些切片作为条件先验传播到正交平面方向，以强制实现平面间的连贯性。 与三维潜在扩散基线模型相比，MPAD将训练和推理的浮点运算次数（FLOPs）分别降低了7倍和3倍，同时减少了推理时间和峰值内存消耗。 在多个数据集上的实验表明，MPAD实现了更优异的性能，能够生成高保真的三维体积，并在单一统一模型内支持“一对多”的转换。

paragraphs.en: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) examinations routinely acquire multiple contrasts, each emphasizing different tissue characteristics and pathological cues. However, collecting all contrasts for every subject increases acquisition time, elevates patient discomfort, and burdens scanner throughput; prolonged scans also heighten susceptibility to motion artifacts that degrade image quality [ 37 , 35 , 19 ] . The challenge is particularly severe for 3D volumetric acquisitions, which require substantially longer scan times due to their increased spatial coverage. This motivates the task of multi-contrast MR image synthesis, which aims to infer missing contrasts from acquired ones, enabling faster scans and more standardized imaging workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 磁共振成像（MRI）检查通常会获取多种对比图像，每种对比图像都突出不同的组织特征和病理线索。 然而，为每位受试者采集所有对比图像会增加扫描时间、加剧患者不适感，并给扫描仪的吞吐量带来负担；扫描时间过长也会增加运动伪影的风险，从而降低图像质量 [ 37 , 35 , 19 ] 。 对于三维容积数据采集而言，这一挑战尤为严峻，因为其空间覆盖范围更大，需要显著更长的扫描时间。 这催生了多对比度MR图像合成任务，其目标是从已获取的图像中推断缺失的对比度，从而实现更快的扫描和更标准化的成像流程。

paragraphs.en: Early work predominantly treated multi-contrast synthesis as a 2D image-to-image translation problem, learning mappings between contrasts such as T1-weighted to T2-weighted images. Generative adversarial networks (GANs) [ 9 ] and variational autoencoders (VAEs) [ 16 ] have been applied to convert slices between contrasts [ 28 , 39 , 17 , 11 , 5 , 13 ] . Although effective in 2D applications, these methods lack modeling of 3D volumetric coherence, resulting in inter-plane inconsistencies and anatomical distortions that hinder their direct application to 3D data.
paragraphs.zh: 早期的研究主要将多对比度合成视为一个二维图像到图像的转换问题，学习不同对比度（例如 T1 加权图像与 T2 加权图像）之间的映射关系。 生成对抗网络（GANs）[ 9 ] 和变分自编码器（VAEs）[ 16 ] 已被用于在不同对比度之间转换图像切片 [ 28 , 39 , 17 , 11 , 5 , 13 ] 。 尽管这些方法在二维应用中效果显著，但它们缺乏对三维体素一致性的建模，导致不同图像平面之间出现不一致性和解剖学失真，从而阻碍了其在三维数据上的直接应用。

paragraphs.en: For 3D multi-contrast MR image synthesis, recent studies improve comprehensive spatial continuity by employing fully volumetric 3D generative architectures, including 3D GAN and 3D diffusion models [ 25 , 1 ] . Although these models better capture anatomical structure, their computational and memory requirements grow cubically with volume size. This limits scalability, especially when a single model is expected to synthesize multiple target contrasts. Latent diffusion frameworks [ 26 ] partly mitigate this by performing generation in a compressed latent space rather than directly in the high-dimensional image space. Nevertheless, even with latent compression, 3D latent diffusion models face substantial practical constraints, including limited computational efficiency, prolonged inference time, and challenges in maintaining synthesis fidelity across multiple contrasts, all of which are critical considerations for real-world clinical applications.
paragraphs.zh: 在三维多对比度磁共振图像合成方面，近期研究通过采用完全体积化的三维生成架构（包括三维 GAN 和三维扩散模型）[25, 1]，提升了全面的空间连续性。 尽管这些模型能更好地捕捉解剖结构，但其计算和内存需求会随着体积尺寸的立方增长而增加。 这限制了模型的扩展性，尤其是在单个模型需要合成多种目标对比度的情况下。 潜在扩散框架 [26] 通过在压缩后的潜在空间而非直接在高维图像空间中执行生成，部分缓解了这一问题。 然而，即使采用了潜在压缩，三维潜在扩散模型仍面临显著的实际限制，包括计算效率有限、推理时间过长，以及在多种对比度间维持合成保真度的挑战；这些对于真实临床应用场景而言都是关键考量因素。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we aim to achieve efficient 3D multi-contrast MR image synthesis using a 2D diffusion model. We propose a unified multi-plane autoregressive diffusion (MPAD) synthesis framework that enables efficient slice-wise generation while preserving 3D anatomical consistency. First, we encode MR volumes into an isotropic latent representation with a 3D autoencoder, which allows for consistent slicing along any anatomical plane orientation. Then, a 2D diffusion model is trained to reconstruct masked target-contrast slices conditioned on the source-contrast slices, unmasked target-contrast slices, and a text embedding specifying the desired target modality. By operating on 2D latent slices instead of full 3D volumes, our formulation avoids the cubic computational scaling of volumetric diffusion while reducing cost and preserving volumetric conditioning.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们的目标是通过使用二维扩散模型，实现高效的三维多对比度磁共振图像合成。 我们提出了一种统一的平面自回归扩散（MPAD）合成框架，该框架能够在保持三维解剖学一致性的同时，高效地逐切片生成图像。 首先，我们通过一个三维自编码器将磁共振体积数据编码为各向同性的潜在表示，从而能够沿任意解剖学平面方向进行一致的切片处理。 接着，我们训练一个二维扩散模型，以源对比度切片、未掩码的目标对比度切片以及指定所需目标模态的文本嵌入为条件，来重建被掩码的目标对比度切片。 由于我们的方法基于二维潜在切片而非完整的三维体积进行操作，因此既避免了体积扩散计算量的立方级增长，又降低了计算成本并保留了体积级的条件信息。

paragraphs.en: Multi-contrast MR image synthesis. Most previous studies in multi-contrast MR image synthesis have utilized 2D slice-based generative models, including GANs and diffusion models, to achieve strong fidelity in one-to-one or many-to-many translations. A representative many-to-many method is MM-GAN [ 28 ] , which synthesizes multiple missing sequences in a single forward pass. Subsequently, diffusion-based methods like M2DN [ 21 ] and APT [ 29 ] were introduced to overcome typical GAN limitations such as mode collapse and limited diversity. However, when applied to 3D volume synthesis in a slice-by-slice manner, a fundamental limitation of these 2D approaches is their lack of explicit mechanisms to ensure volumetric coherence, which often results in anatomical inconsistencies between adjacent slices.
paragraphs.zh: 多对比度 MR 图像合成。 以往大多数关于多对比度 MR 图像合成的研究都采用了基于二维切片的生成模型，包括 GAN 和扩散模型，以实现一对一或多对多转换中的高保真度。 一种典型的多对多方法是 MM-GAN [ 28 ]，它能在单次前向传播中合成多个缺失的序列。 随后，基于扩散的方法如 M2DN [ 21 ] 和 APT [ 29 ] 被引入，以克服 GAN 的典型局限性，例如模式崩溃和多样性有限的问题。 然而，当这些二维方法以逐切片方式应用于三维体积合成时，其一个根本性局限是缺乏确保体积一致性的显式机制，这常常导致相邻切片之间出现解剖学上的不一致。

paragraphs.en: To address this, some works have explored full 3D volumetric synthesis. Methods in this category range from direct 3D adaptations of 2D architectures [ 20 ] to more sophisticated models like cWDM [ 8 ] , which applies diffusion to 3D wavelet coefficients. In parallel, 2D/2.5D approaches attempt to approximate volumetric coherence by exchanging information between neighboring slices [ 6 , 10 ] . While these efforts confirm the importance of 3D consistency, they struggle to enforce long-range dependencies without incurring the prohibitive cost of true 3D generation. This creates a clear need for a framework that can achieve global 3D coherence efficiently, without relying on a full 3D generative model.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这一问题，一些研究探索了完整的三维体素合成方法。 这一类别的方法涵盖从二维架构的直接三维化应用 [ 20 ]，到更复杂的模型（如 cWDM [ 8 ]），后者将扩散模型应用于三维小波系数。 与此同时，二维/2.5D 方法试图通过相邻切片之间的信息交换来近似体素相关性 [ 6 , 10 ]。 尽管这些努力证实了三维一致性的重要性，但它们难以在不产生真正三维生成所带来的高昂成本的前提下，强制实现长距离依赖关系。 这凸显出一种框架的迫切需求：该框架能够高效地实现全局三维相关性，而无需依赖完整的三维生成模型。

paragraphs.en: Latent diffusion for 3D MRI. Recent advances in latent diffusion [ 26 ] have enabled high-fidelity volumetric MR image generation. Generative models like Medical Diffusion [ 14 ] and BrainLDM [ 23 ] learn a 3D generative prior over the latent space of medical images. Make-A-Volume [ 41 ] restores 3D consistency by adding lightweight volumetric layers to a 2D slice-wise model, while the Volumetric Conditioning Module (VCM) [ 2 ] introduces a plug-in module for data-efficient control of pretrained 3D models. Adaptive Latent Diffusion (ALDM) [ 15 ] employs a 3D autoencoder with switchable SPADE [ 22 ] blocks for multi-contrast conditioning. While these methods validate the potential of latent diffusion for preserving volumetric context, their reliance on 3D denoising networks keeps computational requirements substantial.

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive image generation. Autoregressive (AR) generative models predict image content sequentially by conditioning each output on previously generated ones. Early AR models such as PixelRNN and PixelCNN [ 33 , 27 ] operated directly in pixel space, and their sequential nature led to high computational cost. Subsequent approaches shifted to token-based generation, where images are first discretized into latent tokens. Models like DALL-E [ 24 ] and VQ-GAN [ 7 ] demonstrated that AR prediction over learned latent codes yields higher fidelity with substantially reduced complexity. Efficiency was further improved with masked prediction and parallel decoding strategies, as seen in MaskGIT [ 4 ] and multi-scale token prediction models such as VAR [ 31 ] . More recent hybrid approaches introduce continuous token modeling, e.g., GIVT [ 32 ] uses Gaussian mixture prediction, while MAR [ 18 ] integrates diffusion-based denoising into the AR decoding loop.
paragraphs.zh: 自回归图像生成。 自回归（AR）生成模型通过以先前生成的图像作为条件，依次预测图像内容。 早期的自回归模型，如 PixelRNN 和 PixelCNN [ 33 , 27 ]，直接在像素空间进行操作，其序列特性导致了高昂的计算成本。 后续的方法转向了基于标记的生成方式，即首先将图像离散化为潜在标记。 DALL-E [ 24 ] 和 VQ-GAN [ 7 ] 等模型表明，在已学习的潜在编码上进行自回归预测，能够在显著降低复杂度的同时实现更高的保真度。 通过掩码预测和并行解码策略，效率得到了进一步提升，例如 MaskGIT [ 4 ] 和多尺度标记预测模型（如 VAR [ 31 ]）。 更近期的混合方法引入了连续标记建模，例如 GIVT [ 32 ] 使用高斯混合预测，而 MAR [ 18 ] 则将基于扩散的去噪技术整合到了自回归解码流程中。

paragraphs.en: We adapt the core principle of autoregression (AR) for 3D MR image synthesis by factorizing a volume into sequences of 2D slices. Our approach propagates anatomical context across orthogonal planes, enforcing global 3D coherence while retaining the efficiency of slice-wise 2D diffusion and avoiding the memory footprint of full 3D models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将自回归（AR）的核心原则应用于 3D MR 图像合成，通过将体数据分解为一系列 2D 切片序列来实现。 我们的方法在正交平面间传播解剖学上下文，从而确保全局的 3D 一致性，同时保持逐片 2D 扩散的高效性，并避免了完整 3D 模型带来的内存占用问题。

paragraphs.en: We propose MPAD, a framework for 3D multi-contrast MR image synthesis using a 2D autoregressive diffusion model operating in latent space. Training consists of two stages: (i) learning an isotropic 3D latent representation with a 3D autoencoder, and (ii) training a 2D latent diffusion model to reconstruct randomly masked target-contrast slices conditioned on source-contrast slices, both encoded in the 3D latent space. An overview of the training framework is illustrated in Fig. 2 . At inference, we introduce a novel multi-plane autoregressive diffusion strategy. MPAD performs two coupled procedures: Intra-plane Autoregressive Synthesis (IAS) and Inter-plane Prior Inference (IPI). IAS generates slices sequentially within each anatomical plane orientation to maintain intra-plane continuity, while IPI propagates previously generated volumes as inter-plane priors to enforce 3D structural coherence across orthogonal orientations. By combining these mechanisms, MPAD achieves efficient slice-wise generation with global 3D consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 MPAD，这是一个利用在潜在空间中运行的二维自回归扩散模型进行三维多对比度 MR 图像合成的框架。 训练包含两个阶段：(i) 使用三维自编码器学习各向同性的三维潜在表示；以及 (ii) 训练一个二维潜在扩散模型，以源对比度切片为条件，重建随机掩码的目标对比度切片，两者均编码在三维潜在空间中。 训练框架的概述如图 2 所示。 在推理阶段，我们引入了一种新颖的多平面自回归扩散策略。 MPAD 执行两个耦合的过程：平面内自回归合成（IAS）和平面间先验推断（IPI）。 IAS 在每个解剖学平面方向内依次生成切片，以保持平面内的连续性；而 IPI 则将先前生成的体素作为平面间先验进行传播，以在正交方向上确保三维结构的一致性。 通过结合这些机制，MPAD 实现了高效的逐切片生成，并保持了全局的三维一致性。

paragraphs.en: We conduct experiments on two publicly available brain MRI datasets: ADNI [ 30 ] and IXI [ 12 ] . ADNI consists of 737 MRI volumes from patients with Alzheimer’s disease, acquired exclusively with 1.5T GE Medical Systems scanners. The protocol includes T1-weighted (T1w), T2-weighted (T2w), and proton density-weighted (PDw) sequences. IXI comprises 577 brain MRI volumes from healthy participants collected at different sites with varying acquisition parameters. The scans were obtained using 1.5T and 3T Philips scanners and include T1w, T2w, and PDw contrasts. For both ADNI and IXI, we randomly select 100 subjects for evaluation and use all remaining subjects for training. More details are provided in the supplementary material.

paragraphs.en: We adopt a two-stage training strategy following the Latent Diffusion Model (LDM) [ 26 ] framework. In the first stage, we train a KL-regularized autoencoder to learn a compact latent representation of the 3D MRI volumes. The encoder compresses each volume into a latent space with 3 3 channels at 32 × 32 × 32 32\times 32\times 32 resolution, and the decoder reconstructs the original resolution volume. The autoencoder employs a 3D CNN architecture with channel multipliers of 1, 2, and 4, and two residual blocks per resolution level. We train the autoencoder for 1000 epochs. In the second stage, we train a 2D CNN-based diffusion model in the learned latent space. The UNet backbone consists of 2 residual blocks per level and 32 channels per attention head. We employ a linear noise schedule ranging from β 1 = 0.0015 \beta_{1}=0.0015 to β T = 0.0195 \beta_{T}=0.0195 over T = 1000 T=1000 diffusion steps. During training, we apply random masking to the target latent slices with masking ratios uniformly sampled between 0.7 and 1.0. We use the AdamW optimizer with a learning rate of 4 × 10 − 6 4\times 10^{-6} and train for 1000 epochs. To ensure a fair comparison, we train all competing methods for the same number of epochs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用一种两阶段训练策略，遵循潜在扩散模型（LDM）[26] 的框架。 在第一阶段，我们训练一个经过 KL 正则化的自编码器，以学习 3D MRI 体积数据的紧凑潜在表示。 编码器将每个体积压缩为具有 3×3 通道、分辨率为 32×32×32 的潜在空间，而解码器则重建原始分辨率的体积数据。 该自编码器采用 3D CNN 架构，通道乘数分别为 1、2 和 4，每个分辨率级别包含两个残差块。 我们将自编码器训练 1000 个周期。 在第二阶段，我们在已学习的潜在空间中训练一个基于 2D CNN 的扩散模型。 UNet 主干网络在每个级别包含 2 个残差块，每个注意力头的通道数为 32。 我们采用线性噪声调度方案，在 T=1000 个扩散步骤中，噪声系数 β 从 β₁=0.0015 变化到 β_T=0.0195。 训练期间，我们对目标潜在切片应用随机掩码，掩码比率在 0.7 到 1.0 之间均匀采样。 我们使用 AdamW 优化器，学习率为 4×10⁻⁶，并训练 1000 个周期。 为确保公平比较，我们对所有对比方法均进行相同周期的训练。

paragraphs.en: At inference, we perform autoregressive generation along three orthogonal planes using 10 DDIM steps. For the first plane, generation starts from random noise with the 10 timesteps. For subsequent planes, we leverage the previously generated volume as a prior and perform sampling using only 2 timesteps starting from an intermediate timestep τ \tau , thereby significantly reducing computational cost. We quantitatively evaluate synthesis performance using three metrics: peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) (dB), structural similarity index (SSIM) [ 34 ] , and normalized mean squared error (NMSE).
paragraphs.zh: 在推理阶段，我们沿着三个正交平面进行自回归生成，并使用 10 个 DDIM 步长。 对于第一个平面，生成从随机噪声开始，共使用 10 个时间步长。 对于后续平面，我们利用先前生成的体数据作为先验，仅从中间时间步长 τ \tau 开始使用 2 个时间步长进行采样，从而显著降低计算成本。 我们使用三个指标对合成性能进行定量评估：峰值信噪比（PSNR）（dB）、结构相似性指数（SSIM）[34] 以及归一化均方误差（NMSE）。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 and Table 2 present quantitative comparisons on the ADNI and IXI datasets, respectively. Our method achieves competitive or superior performance across all contrast pairs and metrics. On the ADNI dataset, we obtain the highest SSIM scores in five out of six synthesis tasks and consistently achieve the lowest NMSE, demonstrating robust synthesis quality. Notably, for challenging tasks such as PD → \rightarrow T1 and PD → \rightarrow T2, our method significantly outperforms all baselines, improving PSNR by over 2 dB compared to the second-best method. On the IXI dataset, our approach consistently ranks first across all metrics, with particularly strong performance on T2 → \rightarrow T1 and PD → \rightarrow T2 synthesis. These results demonstrate that our autoregressive framework achieves synthesis quality superior to 3D diffusion-based approaches while using only 2D denoising networks.

paragraphs.en: Effect of Autoregressive Synthesis. We evaluate IAS along a single anatomical plane by varying the group size g g , which controls how many slices are generated in parallel at each autoregressive step ( Table 3 ). Relative to the non-AR baseline, introducing IAS consistently improves reconstruction quality on both ADNI and IXI. Smaller group sizes yield incremental but steady gains, as more autoregressive steps enable finer slice-to-slice dependency modeling. Notably, even the non-AR baseline achieves competitive performance. This was driven by two factors. First, the source-contrast information z s ​ r ​ c z_{src} is consistently provided for every slice, offering reliable anatomical guidance throughout the volume regardless of whether previous target slices are available. Second, since this source information is encoded through the 3D multi-modal conditioning encoder (MCE), it inherently captures volumetric structure and spatial context. This 3D-aware source conditioning ensures that the 2D diffusion model receives rich volumetric priors even without explicit autoregressive dependencies on previously generated target slices. However, autoregressive synthesis further improves upon this baseline by additionally providing previously generated target-contrast slices as conditioning, which explicitly enforces slice-to-slice continuity and refines local anatomical consistency in the target contrast. To balance accuracy and efficiency, we use g = 4 g{=}4 in all experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 自回归合成的效果。 我们通过改变组大小 g，在单个解剖学平面上评估 IAS；该参数控制每次自回归步骤中并行生成的切片数量（表 3）。 与非 AR 基线相比，引入 IAS 能持续改善 ADNI 和 IXI 数据集上的重建质量。 较小的组大小会带来逐步但稳定的提升，因为更多的自回归步骤能够更精细地建模切片间的依赖关系。 值得注意的是，即使非 AR 基线也能达到具有竞争力的性能。 这由两个因素驱动。 首先，源对比度信息 z_{src} 始终为每个切片提供，无论先前目标切片是否存在，都能在整个体数据中提供可靠的人体解剖学指导。 其次，由于这些源信息是通过三维多模态条件编码器（MCE）编码的，因此其本身就能捕捉到体数据结构和空间上下文。 这种具备三维意识的源条件机制确保了二维扩散模型即使在没有对先前生成的目标切片进行显式自回归依赖的情况下，也能获得丰富的体数据先验知识。 然而，自回归合成通过额外提供先前生成的目标对比度切片作为条件信息，进一步提升了这一基线性能；这明确地强制了切片间的连续性，并优化了目标对比度中的局部解剖学一致性。 为了在准确性和效率之间取得平衡，我们在所有实验中都使用 g = 4。

paragraphs.en: 2D vs. 3D Multi-modal Conditioning Encoder. We compare 2D and 3D convolutional architectures in the multi-modal conditioning encoder (MCE). As shown in Table 4 , the 3D architecture consistently outperforms its 2D counterpart across both datasets. The 2D architecture processes each slice independently, so conditioning features are encoded without through-plane context, which limits its ability to capture fully 3D anatomical structures. In contrast, 3D convolutions aggregate information across neighboring slices and depth, providing richer volumetric context and leading to more coherent volumes and stronger quantitative performance.

paragraphs.en: Masking Strategy. We evaluate two masking approaches during training: learnable mask tokens versus Gaussian noise. Table 4 shows that Gaussian noise masking substantially outperforms learnable tokens on both datasets. In our framework, the masked target latent is processed by MCE and then injected into the diffusion model via SPADE. When using a learned mask token, masked regions are replaced with constant values that MCE can easily detect and potentially ignore, reducing the usefulness of target-side context. In contrast, Gaussian noise produces continuous, spatially varying corruptions that remain within the natural range of latent activations, forcing MCE to extract robust features from the partially noised target latent.
paragraphs.zh: 掩码策略。 我们在训练期间评估了两种掩码方法：可学习的掩码标记与高斯噪声。 表4显示，在高斯噪声掩码方面，两种数据集上的表现均显著优于可学习标记。 在我们的框架中，被掩码的目标潜在变量会先由 MCE 处理，然后通过 SPADE 注入到扩散模型中。 当使用可学习的掩码标记时，被掩码的区域会被替换为常数，MCE 可以轻松检测到这些常数并可能忽略它们，从而降低了目标侧上下文的有效性。 相比之下，高斯噪声会产生连续且空间上变化的扰动，这些扰动仍保持在潜在激活值的自然范围内，迫使 MCE 从部分被噪声干扰的目标潜在变量中提取稳健的特征。

paragraphs.en: Effect of Inter-plane Priors. We assess the impact of incorporating inter-plane priors from previously generated planes during multi-plane inference. Table 4 demonstrates that using priors consistently improves performance. Without priors, each plane is generated independently from pure noise and simply averaged, lacking cross-plane coordination. In contrast, incorporating inter-plane priors enables subsequent planes to leverage structural information from already completed planes, allowing the model to maintain anatomical consistency across orthogonal orientations. This use of inter-plane priors reduces the denoising burden by starting from a more informed initialization. It also enforces geometric constraints that prevent contradictory predictions between planes, ultimately enhancing both spatial coherence and overall image quality.

paragraphs.en: Effect of Multi-plane Generation. We analyze the effect of each anatomical plane and their combinations in our multi-plane generation framework. Table 5 shows a consistent trend of performance improvements as additional planes are incorporated. Starting from a single plane π 1 \pi_{1} (coronal), adding a second plane π 2 \pi_{2} (sagittal) already yields a noticeable gain in PSNR and SSIM on both ADNI and IXI, highlighting the benefit of complementary views. Generating along two orthogonal planes (e.g., π 2 \pi_{2} and π 3 \pi_{3} ) leads to similar improvements, indicating that the advantage comes from multi-view information rather than a particular choice of plane. Using all three anatomical planes ( π 1 \pi_{1} , π 2 \pi_{2} , π 3 \pi_{3} ) further boosts performance, and an additional refinement pass on the first plane ( π 1 ′ \pi_{1}^{\prime} ) after completing all three planes provides a small but consistent extra gain on both datasets. This refinement pass allows π 1 \pi_{1} to leverage information from all completed views, reducing plane-specific artifacts and leading to more isotropic visual quality. Overall, these results demonstrate that multi-plane generation with a final refinement step effectively aggregates complementary spatial information across orientations, yielding more consistent and higher-quality 3D synthesis.

paragraphs.en: Robustness of Plane Ordering. We analyze the robustness of plane ordering in the proposed IPI framework. As shown in Table 6 , different generation orders yield nearly identical performance across all evaluation metrics, indicating that the synthesis process is largely invariant to the choice of plane sequence. This robustness arises because each plane is generated while conditioned on both source-contrast information and previously synthesized volumes, allowing anatomical context to be progressively accumulated regardless of ordering. Consequently, inter-plane priors provide complementary structural guidance rather than order-dependent constraints, enabling stable multi-plane aggregation and consistent volumetric reconstruction.

paragraphs.en: While our method substantially reduces inference cost compared to existing diffusion-based approaches ( Fig. 1 ), the proposed multi-plane generation still involves sequential cross-plane refinement to enforce volumetric consistency. In our current implementation, reducing the number of inter-plane refinement iterations decreases inference time to approximately 1.8 s per volume, indicating further efficiency headroom without architectural changes. This reflects a controllable trade-off between inference speed and multi-plane consistency. Future work could explore more efficient aggregation mechanisms or parallel generation strategies to further accelerate inference while maintaining the benefits of multi-view consistency. Additionally, distillation techniques or fewer-step sampling methods may offer promising directions for reducing the sampling burden without compromising synthesis quality.

paragraphs.en: We present MPAD, a latent-space framework for 3D multi-contrast MRI synthesis that achieves full-volume generation using only 2D diffusion operations. A 3D autoencoder maps volumes to an isotropic latent representation that supports slicing along arbitrary plane orientations. The diffusion model is trained to reconstruct masked target-contrast slices conditioned on source-contrast slices and target modality specification. At inference, plane-wise autoregressive generation with inter-plane priors and multi-plane aggregation enforces volumetric consistency without full 3D diffusion operations. By reformulating volumetric synthesis as coordinated 2D latent diffusion with structured cross-plane priors, MPAD bridges computational efficiency and global 3D anatomical fidelity within a unified framework. Moreover, the controllable trade-off between inter-plane refinement and inference time highlights the practical flexibility of our approach, enabling adaptation to different deployment constraints. Future work includes further reducing sampling cost through distillation or parallelized multi-plane generation.

sents.en: The diffusion model is trained to reconstruct masked target-contrast slices conditioned on source-contrast slices and target modality specification.
sents.zh: 扩散模型经过训练，能够在给定源对比度切片和目标模态规格的条件下，重建被掩码的目标对比度切片。

sents.en: At inference, plane-wise autoregressive generation with inter-plane priors and multi-plane aggregation enforces volumetric consistency without full 3D diffusion operations.
sents.zh: 在推理阶段，基于平面间先验和跨平面聚合的平面级自回归生成方法，无需完整的 3D 扩散操作即可确保体积一致性。

sents.en: By reformulating volumetric synthesis as coordinated 2D latent diffusion with structured cross-plane priors, MPAD bridges computational efficiency and global 3D anatomical fidelity within a unified framework.
sents.zh: 通过将体积合成重新表述为具有结构化跨平面先验的协调式 2D 潜在扩散，MPAD 在一个统一框架内实现了计算效率与全局 3D 解剖保真度之间的平衡。

sents.en: Moreover, the controllable trade-off between inter-plane refinement and inference time highlights the practical flexibility of our approach, enabling adaptation to different deployment constraints.
sents.zh: 此外，在平面间精细优化与推理时间之间可控的权衡关系，凸显了该方法在实际应用中的灵活性，使其能够适应不同的部署限制。

sents.en: Future work includes further reducing sampling cost through distillation or parallelized multi-plane generation.
sents.zh: 未来的工作包括通过蒸馏或并行化的跨平面生成方法，进一步降低采样成本。
